headline: Wild’s Joel Eriksson Ek leaves game with injury
take: Daily Faceoff reports Joel Eriksson Ek left Minnesota's game with an injury, and he's one of the most important pieces on one of the league's best teams. The Wild are 14-3-4 with 56% of the expected goals (the quality of chances). With Eriksson Ek on the ice at five on five they've had 59%, about nine points better than when he sits. He has 17 points and seven on the power play, and his chances have been even better than his scoring: 11.25 expected goals on his own shots against six goals. His 1.66 expected goals per 60 is well above last season's 1.16. Minnesota has had strong goaltending (14.4 goals fewer allowed than its chances against deserved), which helps absorb a loss, but not one like this. No timeline yet.
